data.description: An upscale Dubai neighborhood known for its blend of modern luxury and traditional charm

data.answer:
Al Sufouh is rich in attractions and amenities, making it a sought-after destination for both residents and tourists. The neighborhood is home to several world-class hotels, including the iconic Burj Al Arab, which offers unparalleled luxury and hospitality. Madinat Jumeirah, with its traditional Arabian architecture, is a major draw, featuring a souk, upscale restaurants, and entertainment options.

Al Sufouh Beach, also known as Black Palace Beach, is a hidden gem offering serene surroundings and crystal-clear waters. Additionally, the area’s proximity to educational institutions, such as Dubai Knowledge Park and Dubai Internet City, enhances its appeal to professionals and families alike.

Featuring numerous waterfront properties, the development is divided into two districts: Al Sufouh 1 and Al Sufouh 2. Al Sufouh 1 begins at Umm Suqeim Street, near its intersection with the Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) toll highway, and is known for landmarks such as Mina A’Salam and the Dubai Police Academy. Al Sufouh 2, located opposite Palm Jumeirah, offers a variety of leisure, entertainment, and retail options.

There are various sub-districts in the area like Al Sufouh Gardens and Acacia Avenues in Al Sufouh 1. Notable apartment buildings in Acacia Avenues include Hilliana Tower Al Sufouh, Cloud 9 Residences, and Bahia 2 Building. Flamingo Villas, a popular villa cluster in this area, features ranch-style villas with 2 and 3-bedroom layouts, surrounded by gardens on all sides. In Al Sufouh, the apartment buildings J5 and J8 are situated along Al Noor Street Road, near Acacia Avenues.

Many properties in Al Sufouh offer stunning views of the Arabian Gulf and the Dubai skyline, along with premium amenities such as private pools, landscaped gardens, and state-of-the-art fitness centers. The community’s well-planned infrastructure ensures that residents enjoy a seamless blend of convenience and luxury.

Off-plan Properties in Al Sufouh Dubai

DAMAC Case is one of the off plan projects in the area. The project features 1-3 bedroom luxury apartments and 3-5 bedroom super luxury suites. DAMAC Case offers breathtaking views of Palm Jumeirah and amenities like private pools, kids play area, and leisure and sports facilities.

Buying a Property in Al Sufouh Community

Looking for Al Sufouh properties for sale? For those interested in owning a smaller unit like a studio in Al Sufouh, there are numerous options available with varying sizes and amenities. The average cost of purchasing a 1-bedroom apartment in Al Sufouh is around AED 1.3M, while 2-bedroom units start at AED 1.9M. 3-bedroom apartments are priced at AED 2.7M minimum. Freehold villa properties are primarily located in the Acacia Avenues community, with limited numbers available for sale. The average cost of buying a four-bedroom villa in Al Sufouh is at least AED 14M.

Rental Properties in Al Sufouh

Searching for rental properties in Al Sufouh? The furnished Al Sufouh apartments are ideal for renting, offering all the essential housing facilities. Studio apartments in Al Sufouh typically cost around AED 54.9k annually. The rental prices for 1-bedroom apartments starts at AED 85k per year, while 3-bedroom apartments can go up to AED 299.9k annually. 4-bedroom Al Sufouh apartments for rent start at AED 300k per year, and rental penthouses are available with annual rents starting from AED 310k.

l Sufouh villas for rent, available in 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom configurations, are plentiful in both districts, with annual prices starting at AED 280k. For a 4-bedroom rental villa, one can expect to pay up to AED 1.2M per year.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Sufouh?

data.answer:
Life in Al Sufouh offers a perfect blend of luxury and tranquility. This prestigious neighborhood is known for its upscale residences, lush green spaces, and proximity to some of Dubai's most iconic landmarks. Residents enjoy a serene environment with easy access to beautiful beaches, world-class dining, and top-notch amenities. The community is well-suited for families, professionals, and expatriates seeking a high standard of living in a prime location. With a mix of modern apartments and luxurious villas, Al Sufouh caters to a variety of lifestyles while maintaining a strong sense of community.

Public Transportation in Al Sufouh Dubai

Public transportation in Al Sufouh is convenient and accessible, making it easy for residents to commute. The area is served by the Al Sufouh Tram Station and several bus routes that connect to major parts of Dubai. 

The Dubai Internet City Metro Station on the Red Line is the nearest Al Sufouh metro station, providing quick access to key business districts, shopping malls, and entertainment venues. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available, ensuring that getting around the city is hassle-free for residents of Al Sufouh.

Supermarkets in Al Sufouh

Al Sufouh offers a range of supermarkets to cater to the daily needs of its residents. Carrefour Market, located in nearby Barsha Heights, provides a wide selection of groceries, fresh produce, and household items. Additionally, Spinneys and Choithrams supermarkets are easily accessible, offering quality products and specialty items. For those who prefer organic and gourmet options, Organic Foods & Café in The Greens is just a short drive away, ensuring that residents have a variety of choices for their shopping needs.

Shopping Malls in and Near the Al Sufouh Area

Residents of Al Sufouh have access to several premier shopping destinations. The Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai's largest and most popular malls, is just a 10-minute drive away. It features a vast array of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment options, including Ski Dubai and a multiplex cinema. Another nearby option is the Dubai Marina Mall, approximately 15 minutes away by car, offering a mix of high-end and mid-range brands, waterfront dining, and leisure activities. These malls provide ample opportunities for shopping, dining, and entertainment, enhancing the lifestyle of Al Sufouh residents.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Sufouh

Al Sufouh is home to several reputable educational institutions, making it an ideal location for families. The Dubai College, known for its high academic standards, offers secondary education following the British curriculum. The American School of Dubai, also nearby, provides an American curriculum from kindergarten to grade 12. For younger children, the International School of Choueifat and GEMS Wellington International School are excellent options, offering a strong foundation in early education. Additionally, there are several nurseries in the vicinity, such as Mosaic Nursery and Raffles Nursery, ensuring that families have access to quality childcare and early learning facilities.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Al Sufouh

Al Sufouh is a diverse community with various places of worship nearby. For Muslim residents, the Al Sufouh Mosque is conveniently located within the neighborhood, offering a peaceful place for daily prayers and community gatherings. The nearby Al Salam Mosque in Al Barsha is another prominent option. For Christian residents, the Emirates Baptist Church International is about a 10-minute drive away in Barsha Heights, providing services and community activities. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple in Bur Dubai, which is approximately a 25-minute drive from Al Sufouh, while the Sikh community can access the Guru Nanak Darbar in Jebel Ali, about 20 minutes away by car.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Al Sufouh Area

Residents of Al Sufouh have access to excellent healthcare facilities. The Mediclinic Al Sufouh is a well-regarded clinic within the community, offering a range of medical services including general practice, pediatrics, and specialist consultations. 

For more comprehensive medical care, the Saudi German Hospital in Al Barsha is a 15-minute drive away, providing advanced healthcare services and emergency care. Additionally, Al Zahra Hospital in Al Barsha offers a wide range of specialties and is known for its high-quality medical services. These facilities ensure that residents of Al Sufouh have easy access to top-notch medical care.

Al Sufouh Location & Nearby Areas

Al Sufouh is strategically located along the western coast of Dubai, making it a prime residential and commercial area. It is bordered by some of Dubai's most prominent neighborhoods, including Dubai Marina to the south and Jumeirah to the north. 

The area is also adjacent to Dubai Internet City and Dubai Media City, making it an ideal location for professionals working in these business hubs. Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), one of Dubai's main highways, runs through Al Sufouh, providing easy access to other parts of the city. The tranquil Emirates Hills and The Lakes communities are nearby, offering additional recreational and lifestyle amenities. With its prime location, Al Sufouh provides residents with a perfect blend of convenience, luxury, and connectivity.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Sufouh

data.answer:
Al Sufouh offers a variety of activities and attractions for residents and visitors. One of the key highlights is the stunning Al Sufouh Beach, also known as Black Palace Beach, which offers a serene and less crowded spot for relaxation and water activities. 

For a cultural experience, visit the Madinat Jumeirah complex, which features traditional Arabian architecture, a bustling souk, and various dining and entertainment options. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round at the nearby Emirates Golf Club, which is just a short drive away. The area is also close to the vibrant Dubai Marina, where you can enjoy yacht cruises, waterfront dining, and a lively atmosphere.

Restaurants in Al Sufouh Community

Al Sufouh boasts a diverse culinary scene with numerous restaurants catering to different tastes. In the Madinat Jumeirah complex, you’ll find a range of high-end dining options, such as Pierchic, which offers seafood with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, and Pai Thai, known for its authentic Thai cuisine. 

For more casual dining, The Greens Souk nearby offers options like Wagamama for Asian cuisine and Nando's for peri-peri chicken. The Black Tap Craft Burgers & Shakes in Jumeirah Al Naseem is another popular spot, known for its gourmet burgers and over-the-top milkshakes.

Beaches In and Near Al Sufouh

Al Sufouh is ideally located near some of Dubai's most beautiful beaches. Al Sufouh Beach Dubai, also known as Black Palace Beach, is a hidden gem offering a peaceful and picturesque setting with clear waters and soft sands. Jumeirah Beach, just a 15-minute drive away, is a more popular spot with plenty of amenities, including sun loungers, cafes, and water sports activities. Kite Beach, also nearby, is perfect for kite surfing and has a vibrant atmosphere with food trucks, beachside gyms, and a skate park.

Hotels in Al Sufouh

While Al Sufouh itself has limited hotel options, it is surrounded by some of Dubai's most luxurious accommodations. The iconic Burj Al Arab hotel near Al Sufouh offers unparalleled luxury and world-class amenities. Madinat Jumeirah, with its stunning Arabian architecture and beautiful waterways, features several high-end hotels such as Al Qasr, Mina A’Salam, and Dar Al Masyaf, each providing a unique and lavish experience. 

The Address Montgomerie in Emirates Hills, a 15-minute drive from Al Sufouh, offers a blend of luxury accommodation and a championship golf course. For business travelers, the Media Rotana in Barsha Heights is conveniently located nearby, offering excellent facilities and comfortable rooms.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Al Sufouh Dubai

Al Sufouh is strategically located near several notable attractions and landmarks. The iconic Burj Al Arab, known for its luxurious amenities and stunning architecture, is just a short drive away. The Madinat Jumeirah complex, featuring traditional Arabian design, a vibrant souk, and numerous dining and entertainment options, is also nearby. 

For shopping enthusiasts, the Mall of the Emirates, home to Ski Dubai and a wide range of retail stores, is easily accessible. Additionally, the Dubai Marina, with its bustling waterfront, dining venues, and yacht cruises, is within close proximity, offering endless leisure activities.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

Al Sufouh provides ample opportunities for outdoor activities, ensuring an active and healthy lifestyle. The serene Al Sufouh Beach is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying the peaceful surroundings. 

For fitness enthusiasts, the area features several well-equipped gyms such as Fitness First and Gold’s Gym, offering state-of-the-art facilities and various fitness classes. Residents can also indulge in pampering sessions at the many salons and spas available in the vicinity, such as The Nail Spa and Tips & Toes, providing a range of beauty and wellness treatments.

data.answer: When considering living in Al Sufouh, there are a few important factors to keep in mind. The area is known for its luxurious lifestyle and prime location, which can come with higher property prices and rental rates compared to other parts of Dubai. The community is well-suited for families, professionals, and expatriates seeking a serene and upscale living environment. While public transportation is readily available, having a car can be beneficial for easier access to the wider range of attractions and amenities in Dubai. Additionally, the well-planned infrastructure and proximity to business hubs like Dubai Internet City and Dubai Media City make Al Sufouh an ideal choice for those working in these areas.

Al Sufouh offers a variety of residential properties, including luxurious villas, modern apartments, and penthouses, catering to different preferences and lifestyles.

How is public transportation in Al Sufouh?

Al Sufouh is well-connected by public transportation, with several bus routes and the Dubai Internet City Metro Station nearby, making it convenient for residents to commute to various parts of Dubai.

Are there good schools and nurseries in Al Sufouh?

Yes, Al Sufouh is home to several reputable educational institutions, including Dubai College and the American School of Dubai, as well as numerous nurseries such as Mosaic Nursery and Raffles Nursery, providing quality education for children of all ages.

What amenities and facilities are available in Al Sufouh?

Al Sufouh offers a range of amenities, including beautiful beaches, fitness centers, salons, and spas. The area is also close to major shopping malls, dining options, and leisure attractions, ensuring a comfortable and convenient lifestyle for its residents.

nodes.title: Shahrukhz
nodes.about:
Shahrukhz by Danube is a landmark 55-storey tower named after Bollywood megastar Shahrukh Khan, created to honour 33 years of excellence shared by both the star and Danube Properties. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, it introduces a new commercial destination with 488 offices and over 40 world-class amenities.

Shahrukhz at Al Sufouh offers high ROI potential through premium office concepts, lifestyle-rich amenities, and elevated corporate design. Blending iconic branding with future-ready workspaces, it creates a distinguished address for companies seeking visibility, efficiency, and long-term growth.

nodes.title: Fairmont Residences Dubai Skyline
nodes.about:
Fairmont Residences Dubai Skyline by RSG Group of Companies redefines luxury living in the heart of Sufouh Gardens. Rising 54 storeys high, this prestigious residential and hotel development is a landmark collaboration with Accor, Europe’s largest hospitality group. The tower features 122 exquisitely designed residences, including 2–3 bedroom apartments, 4-bedroom half-floor Sky Mansions, and ultra-exclusive 4-bedroom full-floor Sky Palaces. Each home boasts one or more balconies, with select units offering maid’s rooms, studies, and even media rooms. Residents can choose from five refined layout styles—Opulent, Harmony, Serenity, Regal, and Tranquility Suites—designed to cater to diverse luxury lifestyles.

Every detail of the interiors is crafted by award-winning designer Kristina Zanic, incorporating rich marble, walnut wood, leather accents, and bronze finishes to create a sophisticated ambiance. The building’s iconic asymmetric balconies are beautifully illuminated at night, offering striking visual appeal. Residents enjoy breathtaking views of the sea and Dubai skyline, along with world-class amenities such as the Fairmont Spa, Gold Lounge, Fairmont Fit gym, outdoor pool, gourmet restaurant, and stylish bar and lounge. Fairmont Residences invites discerning buyers into a world where elegance, design, and hospitality converge seamlessly.

nodes.title: Cavalli Tower
nodes.about:
Cavalli Tower by DAMAC rises majestically in the prestigious Al Sufouh area, offering a distinctive blend of architectural elegance and beachfront serenity. This iconic 70-storey tower showcases an exclusive selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside luxurious 3 and 4-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is crafted to the highest standards, combining contemporary design with sophisticated interiors.

Developed by DAMAC Properties and envisioned by acclaimed architect Shaun Killa, Cavalli Tower features a selection of exceptional lifestyle amenities, including sky-high pools and fine dining venues. Select apartments come equipped with private pools or Jacuzzis, offering an elevated living experience. This project represents a seamless integration of luxury, location, and lifestyle.
